claim: Event patterns for event buses can match against the event source, event metadata, and/or event detail values. Event metadata is data about the event, such as the event source, or the account or Region in which the event originated; event content is the actual property values of the event data.

values.display: event metadata, and/or event detail values
The actual property values of the event data

evidence.quote: Event patterns for event buses can match against the event source, event metadata, and/or event detail values.

Event metadata – Data about the event, such as the event source, or the account or Region in which the event originated. Event data – The properties of the event itself. These properties vary according to event. Event content – The actual property values of the event data.
